description: How long the watch of the uploaded files waits before its next round (docs/SPEC.md FR-3.2), in seconds, from the rounds in a row with a failed read and the seconds since the watch started: 2 after a round where every read answered, doubling after each round with a failure up to a minute, and null, giving up, after 8 such rounds in a row or once the watch has run 10 minutes, so a file the server holds in processing isn't read for hours. A round that fails partway counts as one, whatever the reads before the failure answered. The map is read again on every return anyway.
